title: Common hook output
description: Output fields accepted from every hook of a Claude Code event, with the Claude Code meaning.
$comment: Fragment: openness is decided by the including event schema.

continue.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1068). In Claude Code, false stops Claude entirely. In Zed it is a PAUSE, not a cut: the tool results already produced are kept, no further model request is sent, Zed shows `stopReason`, and the conversation waits for the user. Last resort only: a guard first denies with a reason (the model goes on another way), and asks for the pause only after repeated denials. On PreToolUse it also denies the tool, with `stopReason` as the reason, and stops the chain like any denial. On other events the chain runs to its end, then the pause applies.

stopReason.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1069). Message shown to the user when `continue` is false; in Zed, shown at the pause.

suppressOutput.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1070). Accepted and ignored (Claude Code documents it as having no effect).

systemMessage.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1071). Warning shown to the user in the agent panel.

terminalSequence.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1072). Accepted and ignored by Zed: Zed has no terminal of its own to emit it to.
